rows.answer: We delivered **2,328 loads in August**, counted as loads with an actual delivery timestamp in that month.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_in_august FROM loads WHERE delivery_actual >= '2026-08-01' AND delivery_actual < '2026-09-01' AND delivery_actual IS NOT NULL

rows.answer: Bluegrass Haulers LLC (carrier ID 42) had the most late deliveries on September 2026 pickups, with 17 late loads. The next-highest carriers had 6 each. The contact on file is Darnell Wright at **(615) 555-0125**. I filtered on actual pickup date and counted a delivery as late when delivery_actual was after delivery_appt. The carriers table lists a single contact per carrier, so confirm that this is the dispatcher you want.
sql:
SELECT c.carrier_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, COUNT(*) AS late_deliveries
FROM loads l
JOIN carriers c ON c.carrier_id = l.carrier_id
WHERE l.pickup_actual >= '2026-09-01' AND l.pickup_actual < '2026-10-01'
  AND l.delivery_actual > l.delivery_appt
GROUP BY c.carrier_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone
ORDER BY late_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5;
